detectors.label: Outlier fraction (adj. boxplot)
detectors.hint: Fraction outside medcouple-adjusted Tukey fences; Hubert & Vandervieren 2008

detectors.label: ADWIN drift signal
detectors.hint: 1.0=drift detected in current window, 0.0=stable

detectors.label: Benford's Law fit (1−p)
detectors.hint: 1 − p-value from chi-square vs expected first-digit frequencies

detectors.label: Changepoint probability
detectors.hint: Max posterior probability of a changepoint in the current window

detectors.label: Custom callable score
detectors.hint: Score returned by user-supplied callable; thresholds configurable via warn_threshold/fail_threshold on the Check

detectors.label: Chi-square drift (1−p)
detectors.hint: 1 − p-value from chi-square test for categorical drift; warn p<0.05, fail p<0.01

detectors.label: Cramér's V (drift)
detectors.hint: V from 2×k contingency table; 0=no drift, 1=maximum categorical drift

detectors.label: CUSUM alarm level
detectors.hint: Normalised CUSUM statistic; >1.0 moderate shift, >2.0 large shift

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (double-MAD)
detectors.hint: Fraction flagged by asymmetric double-MAD; robust on skewed distributions

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (ECOD)
detectors.hint: Fraction of rows with ECOD score above reference 95th percentile

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (GESD)
detectors.hint: Fraction of outliers found by Generalized ESD (Rosner 1983)

detectors.label: Grubbs outlier (1−p)
detectors.hint: 1 − p-value from Grubbs test; warn p<0.05, fail p<0.01

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (HBOS)
detectors.hint: Fraction of rows with HBOS score above reference 95th percentile

detectors.label: Anomaly fraction (HW)
detectors.hint: Fraction of current values outside Holt-Winters prediction interval

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (IQR)
detectors.hint: Fraction of values outside Tukey IQR fences; k=1.5 by default

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (IF)
detectors.hint: Fraction of rows classified as anomalies by Isolation Forest

detectors.label: Jensen-Shannon distance
detectors.hint: JS distance (bounded [0,1]); 0=identical, 1=maximally different

detectors.label: KL divergence
detectors.hint: Kullback–Leibler divergence (binned); 0=identical distributions

detectors.label: KS drift (1−p)
detectors.hint: 1 − p-value from two-sample KS test; warn p<0.05, fail p<0.01

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (LOF)
detectors.hint: Fraction of rows with LOF > threshold; warn 5%, fail 10%

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (MAD)
detectors.hint: Fraction of values with |modified Z| > 3.5

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (Mahal.)
detectors.hint: Fraction of rows outside chi-square critical ellipsoid at p=0.01

detectors.label: Discord fraction (MP)
detectors.hint: Fraction of subsequences whose nearest-neighbour distance exceeds reference 95th percentile

detectors.label: MMD drift
detectors.hint: Maximum Mean Discrepancy; 0=identical, 1=maximally different

detectors.label: Mutual information (norm.)
detectors.hint: Normalized MI between periods; higher=more similar; warn<0.50, fail<0.30

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (OC-SVM)
detectors.hint: Fraction of rows classified as outliers by One-Class SVM

detectors.label: Outlier fraction drift
detectors.hint: Deviation of current outlier fraction from historical baseline range

detectors.label: Page-Hinkley alarm
detectors.hint: Normalised PH statistic; alarm when PH−min(PH) exceeds threshold

detectors.label: Anomaly fraction (Prophet)
detectors.hint: Fraction of current values outside Prophet uncertainty interval

detectors.label: Population Stability Index
detectors.hint: PSI<0.1 stable, 0.1–0.2 moderate shift, >0.2 significant population shift

detectors.label: Remote endpoint score
detectors.hint: Score returned by external HTTP endpoint; must return {"score": float}

detectors.label: STL residual Z-score
detectors.hint: Max absolute Z-score of STL residuals over the current window

detectors.label: Wasserstein-1 (norm.)
detectors.hint: Earth-mover distance normalized by reference std; 0.2=moderate shift, 0.5=large

detectors.label: Outlier fraction (Z-score)
detectors.hint: Fraction of values with |Z| > threshold; valid only under normality

checks.label: Date-part completeness
checks.hint: Fraction of expected date buckets with no data

checks.label: Data freshness
checks.hint: Seconds since the most recent row timestamp

checks.label: Null fraction
checks.hint: Fraction of rows where the column is NULL

checks.label: Referential integrity
checks.hint: Fraction of FK values present in parent table

checks.label: Row count in range
checks.hint: 1.0 if row count in the date window is outside [min_rows, max_rows]; 0.0 if within range

checks.label: SQL assertion violation
checks.hint: Fraction of rows failing the custom SQL condition

checks.label: String case violation
checks.hint: Fraction of rows with wrong case
